description: Use this when someone asks about a company or wants one checked. Give the company's name and, if known, its city or country. If a recent report on the company is stored, it comes back at once; otherwise a new report starts and the answer says when it will be ready. A new report uses one of the reader's reports; asking again for the same company does not. When several companies match the name, the answer lists them: ask the reader which one they mean, then call this again with that company's choice token. LightRay checks companies, not people.

choice.description: The choice token of one company from the list this tool returned when several matched. Give it with the same name.

name.description: The company's name, as it is registered if known: its legal name with its legal form, such as Limited or LLC.

place.description: The company's city or country, if known. It helps find the right company.

name: check_company
title: Check a company
